authority.bootstrap_extension: orchestration only; may request/read/reuse/renew Message Board presence and hard-hold duplicate dispatch

activation_boundary.reason: library bootstrap historically composes a read snapshot; an implicit Python method call must not become a shared Git mutation

compatibility.rehydration_observers: task-only MCP boots observe the board but do not create competing PRIMARY claims

failure_policy.read_only_unverified: advisory standing only; never upgraded to execution claim

coordination_claim_mode.existing_active_claim: preserved when caller leaves this unset

inputs.targets: optional exact shared-sink/artifact paths used by Message Board overlap semantics
inputs.work_key: optional explicit identity; absence remains NONE and is not fabricated

lease_policy.expired_presence: Message Board present may establish a new claim while historical events remain preserved
lease_policy.reason: avoid self-induced Git HEAD churn and false refresh invalidation
lease_policy.reuse_without_commit: matching ACTIVE presence with sufficient lease remains valid

AUTO: shared-fresh Message Board read before world-state composition
reuse compatible active self-claim without mutation while lease remains healthy
renew compatible claim only near expiry
exact duplicate or incompatible active self-claim => HOLD

ordering: resolve whether this is observation or explicit start-work intent
for MCP tool boot, perform Message Board handshake
only explicit start-work intent may establish/reuse/renew presence
compose canonical AGENT_BOOT_V1 world/continuation packet on the resulting Git head
attach coordination projection and hard hold when explicit claimed work collides

pre_dispatch.ADVISORY_ONLY: observer/task-only tool boot; no execution claim
pre_dispatch.ALLOW: explicit AUTO/start-work intent has a shared-current durable compatible presence claim
pre_dispatch.HOLD: explicit AUTO/start-work intent cannot establish a shared-current compatible claim

purpose: Make shared-current Message Board coordination automatic at the MCP boot boundary without confusing observation/reconstruction with work-start, and without creating a second presence, claim, message, party, scheduler, or truth authority.

excludes: transition label such as PRESENT vs PRESENCE_REUSED
routing_digest.law: routine lease reuse must not manufacture a coordination change

observed_regression_repair.observation: four legacy/continuation tests failed because implicit boot was treated as work-start and wrote Message Board claims
observed_regression_repair.repair: split activation policy from mechanism; implicit task-only tool boot becomes READ_ONLY, direct Python boot becomes DISABLED by default, explicit work identity or explicit AUTO still claims
observed_regression_repair.standing: observed CI failure informed this policy; repaired head requires fresh exact-head CI
